scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the Port Crescent dock-access credential packet for the Beacon Lines installation crew before the orientation file closes.
Emerging Need: The portal application is opened and partly completed, then the same application becomes locked at sponsor verification.
Decision Context: The visible alerts identify the blocked application and cutoff, but the correct sponsor identity is only in the service-contact roster.
Consequence: If sponsor reactivation is not pursued while the token is still live, the crew cannot be cleared for the scheduled dock orientation.

parameter.title: Finish Port Crescent dock-access portal entry
parameter.description: Portal entry block for Beacon Lines installation crew credential packet; submit after invite opens.

parameter.subject: PCMC dock access application PCMC-DA-884 started
parameter.body: Your Port Crescent dock-access application PCMC-DA-884 has been opened from the Beacon Lines invite. Crew roster step is saved; truck certificate upload is the next step.

parameter.content: Loading dock security says PCMC-DA-884 is now halted on the sponsor-verification screen. Outside submitters cannot move to the certificate upload until a registered Port Crescent sponsor reactivates the token.

parameter.subject: Reactivation window for PCMC-DA-884
parameter.body: Application PCMC-DA-884 remains locked with no upload or edit buttons available. Sponsor reactivation can be accepted until 12:00 PM Eastern today; expired tokens roll into next week's security batch.

parameter.subject: PCMC-DA-884 token expired
parameter.body: The sponsor-verification token for PCMC-DA-884 expired at 12:00 PM Eastern. This application can no longer be reactivated for Friday dock orientation badges.
